purpose: Propose an A/B evidence-tier split and a preregistered negative-result track without weakening the existing fail-closed, independence, privacy, or anti-pseudorep boundaries. This draft does not lower the registered quota, admit a source role, write the effective catalog, award credit, authorize training, or change the L2 Gate.

quota_amendment_semantics: The train family and lineage numbers are provisional pilot operating lower bounds, not statistical power proof.
Independent family and lineage requirements prevent a single source, run, or repeated view from masquerading as sample size.
The registered amendment permits adding independent families, narrowing metrics or paper claims, or publishing a new amendment before model invocation; it does not permit post-result quota lowering.
examples_used_as_design_evidence_only: Toyota HSR bounded probe: technical completion with source-role rejection.
LO2v2 and COW bounded paths: audit evidence does not automatically become train admission.
LogChunks and other metadata-only candidates: stop-loss is preferred absent prior evidence for B-tier gates.

tier_A.meaning: A is an audit-evidence tier, not a train source role. It records identity and bounded structural/Gate evidence while preserving all source-role and credit prohibitions.
minimum_evidence: Frozen identity contract and exact source identity when an acquisition exists.
Reader and bounded probe identity are pinned and the result is sanitized aggregate-only.
The probe records privacy, notice, outcome, lineage, pointer, and source-role Gate booleans without persisting raw paths, raw member content, protected labels, ground truth, or PII.
Any failed Gate is retained as a first-class negative or hold finding; it is not silently dropped.
allowed_outputs: A separate metadata/audit catalog or evidence register, if separately authorized and clearly marked audit-only.
Sanitized Gate maps, failure dispositions, search coverage, and negative-result evidence.
forbidden_outputs: Source-role admission, quota or lineage credit, sample generation, or L2 passage.

tier_B.meaning: B is the only tier that may be considered for train source-role admission, subject to a separate source-role review and the registered quota audit.

required_gates.pointer_and_credit_semantics: Must be explicitly closed by the B-specific contract. An unbound pointer never yields pointer, lineage, or quota credit.

admission_boundary: A does not count toward B or toward the train quota.
A partial surface, failed Gate, or repeated view cannot be combined with another partial surface to manufacture one B family.
B admission requires a new explicit source-role disposition after the relevant evidence and quota audit; it is never automatic from a successful technical probe.

credit.family: Only after explicit B admission and quota audit; not created by this draft.
credit.lineage: Only after independent lineage closure; not created by this draft.
credit.sample: Only after separate training-scope authorization; not created by this draft.
credit.quota: Only after the effective catalog is separately amended; not created by this draft.

invariants_not_open_for_relaxation: Identity is not role; role is not credit; credit is not L2 passage.
Independent family and lineage evidence remain mandatory for any B-tier train claim.
No half-family, composite-family, repeated-view, packet-window, template, prompt-view, or duplicate-row counting may close an independence gate.
No protected outcome, label, ground truth, credential, command, payload, PII, raw path, raw notice, or ordinary member content may enter model-visible or persistent audit output.
Fail-closed behavior, Bypass prohibition, and exhausted-attempt hard stops remain unchanged.
A result observed after model invocation may not be used to retroactively lower a quota or gate.

negative_result_track.permitted_claim: Within the frozen privacy, notice, outcome, lineage, and independence gates and the declared public metadata-search universe, the current search path has not identified enough B-tier families to support the registered train L2 pilot target.
claim_scope: The claim is bounded by the declared search universe, date, query protocol, and exclusion rules.
The claim reports a supply and gate-closure boundary, not a universal statement that no qualifying data exists.
The claim does not establish statistical power, model quality, prevalence, or general-world validity.
required_evidence_ledger: Search-universe definition and public registry sources.
Search date range, query terms, revision policy, and candidate deduplication rule.
Candidate-level identity, license, revision, and metadata-only reason codes.
Independent-family and lineage evidence available before any model call.
Disposition for every screened candidate: B candidate, A hold, reject, failed acquisition, or vacant.
A denominator and stop rule; do not report B≈0/4 without naming the screened set.
non_claims: No claim that public corpora universally cannot satisfy the quota.
No claim that a technical A-tier audit is a trainable B-tier source.
No claim that a negative result passes L2 or authorizes training.
No claim that the current search is exhaustive beyond its declared universe.

continue_only_if_prior_evidence_exists: Curator or official metadata already declares at least four independent, label-independent execution or capture groups.
The declaration is not merely files, directories, rows, hosts, sensors, date windows, or repeated views.
Outcome-blind lineage and protected-outcome exclusion are plausibly defensible before payload access.
A new topic-specific contract and execution-authority are prepared and separately approved.

failed_acquisition_paths.REPROD: remain failed; do not resume or retry without a new contract and authority
failed_acquisition_paths.PANDAcap: remain failed or under existing disposition; do not reopen silently
failed_acquisition_paths.Toyota: remain held metadata candidate and rejected source role
failed_acquisition_paths.St_Gallen: remain held/rejected for the existing path; a v0.2 method requires a new contract

future_quota_change_requires: A separate amendment before model invocation.
A written scientific rationale independent of observed model results.
An updated capacity audit and explicit review of train/development/test implications.

review_questions: Should A-tier metadata evidence be recorded in a separate audit-only register, or remain documents-only?
Should B-tier pointer binding be a hard requirement, or should a future B contract define a safe unbound exception without awarding pointer credit?
What exact search universe and denominator should be preregistered for the negative-result claim?
What review authority should approve an effective quota change, if any, before model invocation?

hard_stop.next_action: Review this draft. It is not effective until a separately authorized amendment is approved and committed; until then the existing quota and L2 Gate remain unchanged.
